response.justification: Bogdan is a broadly experienced, senior-level engineer with a strong craftsmanship mindset, open-source leadership, and rare, directly relevant experience building developer tooling (C/C++ components for NI LabWindows/CVI, an IDE; plus test runners and libraries for D). However, the role's core requirements — deep JVM expertise, strong Java and Kotlin, and solid Spring/Hibernate/Quarkus experience — are largely absent. Java appears only peripherally (robotic arms and a mobile device orchestration tool nearly a decade ago), Kotlin and Spring do not appear at all, and the last 7+ years are almost entirely TypeScript/Node and DLang. The gap on the mandatory enterprise-JVM stack is too large for a mid-senior IC expected to own enterprise framework subsystems from day one.
strengths: Real IDE/dev-tooling experience (LabWindows/CVI, test runners, MCP code generators)
Deep systems and performance work (low-latency services at millions of req/s)
Strong engineering craft: TDD, CI/CD, open-source ownership, teaching and talks
concerns: No demonstrated Kotlin or Spring/Hibernate/Quarkus experience
Java exposure is minimal and dated (~2016–2018, secondary to DLang)
Recent decade centered on TypeScript/Node, not the JVM ecosystem
